LanguageData.LC_FourColor_RiskLevel.label: E.G.O risk level
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_RiskLevel.description: Lobotomy Corporation risk grade (ZAYIN, TETH, HE, WAW, ALEPH). Comparing attacker and defender risk grades adjusts incoming four-color damage.
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_DamageType.label: four-color damage type
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_DamageType.description: The Lobotomy Corporation four-color damage type dealt by this weapon: RED (physical HP), WHITE (mental SP), BLACK (HP + SP erosion), or PALE (% max HP).
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_WeaponDamage.label: weapon damage (four-color)
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_WeaponDamage.description: Effective base attack damage dealt by this E.G.O weapon after four-color weapon multipliers, quality scaling, and Old Belief blessing. PALE weapons deal percentage damage of the target's core max HP.
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_SkillDamage.label: E.G.O skill damage
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_SkillDamage.description: Total four-color damage output and per-stage breakdown of the E.G.O weapon's active ability, including multi-hit sequences and quality/blessing scaling.
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_DamageMultiplier.label: four-color damage multiplier
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_DamageMultiplier.descriptio: Effective four-color damage output multiplier for this weapon, including base tuning, quality scaling, and Old Belief blessing.
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistRed.label: RED resistance
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistRed.description: Incoming RED (physical) damage multiplier. Lower values provide stronger mitigation (0.0 = Immune, <0.5 = Resist, <1.0 = Endure, 1.0 = Normal, >1.0 = Weak, >=2.0 = Fatal).
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistWhite.label: WHITE resistance
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistWhite.description: Incoming WHITE (mental) damage multiplier. Lower values provide stronger mitigation (0.0 = Immune, <0.5 = Resist, <1.0 = Endure, 1.0 = Normal, >1.0 = Weak, >=2.0 = Fatal).
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistBlack.label: BLACK resistance
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistBlack.description: Incoming BLACK (erosion: physical + mental) damage multiplier. Lower values provide stronger mitigation (0.0 = Immune, <0.5 = Resist, <1.0 = Endure, 1.0 = Normal, >1.0 = Weak, >=2.0 = Fatal).
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistPale.label: PALE resistance
LanguageData.LC_FourColor_ResistPale.description: Incoming PALE (soul / max HP percentage) damage multiplier. Lower values provide stronger mitigation (0.0 = Immune, <0.5 = Resist, <1.0 = Endure, 1.0 = Normal, >1.0 = Weak, >=2.0 = Fatal).
